saw_lines: Underwear is bought by fit, then reordered in the same size, so one good fit keeps a buyer coming back.
So the sale is won in the first line, where a shopper decides whether the brand fits them at all.
Your 0 of 16 copy ads carry a proof number, so open the next batch with one real figure, such as orders shipped, in line one.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 27 Oct 2026
points: 0 of 16 ads carry a proof number, so a first-time buyer has no figure to trust before clicking. Pick a number you can back up, such as orders shipped or pieces sold, and open the next batch with it.
4 of 16 copy ads open on “great outfits start with the”, and 12 more use seven other openers, so new viewers get no clear story. Test two angles against that opener: sizes XS-6X and all day comfort.
9 of your 30 Shop now ads send buyers to the homepage, not to the print in the creative. A shopper who clicks a print ad has to find the design alone. Point each to the print it shows.
Your site promotes free shipping, yet 0 of 16 copy ads mention it, so a new buyer has no reason to act today. Put free domestic shipping in the first line of three new ads for first-time buyers.

ads_1: Two new opener angles on sizes and comfort, with free shipping in line one
